format: contextual NPC portrait or item image
rules: Setting/location art is strongly preferred when the setting changes or first becomes relevant.
Use one contextual person/item image at the narration beat where it matters; do not front-load galleries.
Titles and descriptions stay extremely brief.
Mechanical UI appears inline only when triggered: checks, combat, damage, resources, inventory, quest/milestone or relationship change.
First meaningful relevance creates canonical art if no dedicated asset exists.
Canonical art is reused. New variants require a meaningful state change such as injury, age, corruption, equipment overhaul, season, destruction, or transformation.
Future per-entity art should contain no embedded labels or prose; chat supplies title/description beneath it.
